# Ollama Management

This layer is responsible for managing Ollama releases and models, including hashing archive files, updating model pinning, and computing checksums.

## Overview

The Ollama Management layer includes scripts that handle various tasks related to Ollama releases and models. It ensures that all necessary files are correctly hashed, model pinning is updated, and checksums are computed.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`scripts/archive-hashes.js`](../scripts/archive-hashes.js) | Lists files in an Ollama release archive. | `hashArchive`, `hashTar`, `wanted`, `field` |
| [`scripts/update-models.js`](../scripts/update-models.js) | Records model pinning digests. | `fetchPin`, `manifestUrl`, `pinFromManifest`, `main` |
| [`scripts/update-ollama.sh`](../scripts/update-ollama.sh) | Computes release and model digests. |  |

## How it works

- `scripts/archive-hashes.js`:
  - Defines functions to hash archive files.
  - Lists files in an Ollama release archive.
  - Defines variables like `hashArchive`, `hashTar`, `wanted`, and `field`.

- `scripts/update-models.js`:
  - Records model pinning digests.
  - Defines functions to fetch pinning information and update model manifests.
  - Defines variables like `fetchPin`, `manifestUrl`, and `pinFromManifest`.

- `scripts/update-ollama.sh`:
  - Computes release and model digests.
  - This script is a shell script that handles the computation of digests for Ollama releases and models.

## Configuration

- Configuration files: `pins/models.json`.
